T_CORP.description: Lucent Technologies Inc. spinoff (0.324084 shares per T share; IRS Form 8937 / Section 355)
T_CORP.note: Distributed by AT&T Corp., the pre-2005 Ma Bell registrant, which the audited rosters list as its own issuer (docs/DATA_PROVENANCE.md 4.3.11). Keyed to T_CORP rather than T: the modern T is the SBC-lineage AT&T Inc., which did not make this distribution, and keying it there would credit the wrong holders while silently denying the right ones.
